## Summary

Describe the problem and the change.

## Validation

- [ ] `flutter analyze`
- [ ] `flutter test`
- [ ] Tested on Android when the change affects native widgets or UI

## Privacy and release checklist

- [ ] No personal photos, local paths, credentials, keys or generated APKs
- [ ] PNG alpha and aspect ratio remain intact when image handling changes
- [ ] Tests and documentation were updated when needed
